title: Browser Recorder (Aryan Gupta, 2023 GSoC)
description: How the Client Side Integration add-on and Zest's client statements appear in zap-extensions around the 2023 Browser Recorder project.
narrative:
Setting up a session by hand is tedious for most ZAP users, so a project that could record those steps was probably welcome. In the summer of 2023 a Google Summer of Code project set out to make that step largely automatic: a browser extension that records user actions and turns them into a Zest script, with a Client Side Integration add-on handling communication with ZAP.

The first version of the client add-on was committed on 26 May 2023. It added the API, a client map, and history and details panels. Over the following months, Aryan Gupta's commits added dialogs for the new client statements to the Zest add-on, and on 30 August 2023 the two add-ons were connected. The blog post describing the recorder followed on 11 September 2023, the same day the client add-on's first release, 0.0.1, is dated.

The Student Hall of Fame lists Aryan Gupta for the work. Both add-ons are still maintained. The client add-on reached 0.35.0 in November 2026, and the Zest changelog records authentication support for client-side scripts. Other add-ons, including authhelper and quickstart, now depend on the client add-on, so the bridge built that summer probably sits on the usual route into a modern ZAP session.

chapters.title: The Hall of Fame entry and the launch post
chapters.text: The Student Hall of Fame lists Aryan Gupta for "Browser Recorder", GSoC, 2023 Summer, with blog and add-on links. The blog post, dated 2023-09-11, says the recorder is a browser extension that records user actions and converts them to a Zest script, that it uses the Client Side Integration add-on to talk to ZAP, and that the Zest add-on gains a "Client (browser) side script" record type. The browser extension itself lives in a separate repository that is not analysed here.

chapters.title: May to July 2023: the client add-on and Zest dialogs
chapters.text: The first commit under addOns/client is "Client: First version" by Simon Bennetts, dated 2023-05-26; it adds ClientIntegrationAPI.java, ClientMap.java and history and details panels. A commit by Aryan Gupta dated 2023-07-05 is "zest: add dialogs for new client statements (#4698)"; it adds dialogs such as ZestClientElementMouseOverDialog and ZestClientWindowResizeDialog under the Zest add-on. Between those two, "zest: update Zest library" (2023-06-26) is by thc202.

chapters.title: August to September 2023: connecting Client and Zest
chapters.text: "added support to allow Client to communicate with Zest  (#4730)" by Aryan Gupta is dated 2023-08-30 and adds ClientZestRecorder.java and ExtensionClientZest.java to the client add-on. Other commits by Aryan Gupta: "scripts: allow to display a script without focusing (#4768)" (2023-08-10), "scripts: allow script node to set focus as optional (#4859)" (2023-09-06) and "zest: fixes the focus issue being caused while recording zest scripts (#4809)" (2023-09-08). The client changelog dates its 0.0.1 release "First version." on 2023-09-11, the same day as the blog post; "Disable client events only for Zest recording" by thc202 is dated 2023-09-20.

chapters.title: Where it stands
chapters.text: Both add-ons exist at HEAD. The client changelog lists 0.35.0 on 2026-11-18. The Zest changelog lists, for 48.12.0 (2026-02-13), "Now supports authentication for client side scripts" and a fix for "Bug which prevented client side scripts from being recorded in ZAP". In the dataset, addon:authhelper and addon:quickstart list addon:client as a dependency.
